lead_raw_text:
The structure of Pm4Ru4Pt4 (PmRuPt) crystallizes in the cubic space group F-43m (No. 216), with 12 atoms per unit cell distributed over three independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis shows all three elements adopt 12-neighbor close-packed-like local arrangements: Pm is surrounded by 8 Pt and 4 Ru, while Pt and Ru each coordinate to 4 Pm and 8 of the other metal. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single three-dimensional component spanning all 12 sites, and validated polyhedron-sharing analysis reveals corner-, edge-, and face-sharing among Pt–Pt and Ru–Ru 12-vertex polyhedra, as well as corner- and edge-sharing between Pm and Pt or Ru polyhedra.
